title: PS Tap Heros Kaitun
features:
Tap Heroes
"Fastest Farm" [Added] = brought the OP Fastest Farm straight into the event — rips thru the levels way faster than the game's own auto, so u shoot up + pile coins on full autopilot.
"Smart Boss Farm" [Added] = every event has those boss chests that reset on a timer + just wall u if ur too weak. this one reads the boss, and if it sees u cant take it down in time it drops u back to farm + power urself up, then climbs back and clears it on its own. no more standing there stuck on a boss u cant break. dont think any other hub does ts ⭐
"Auto Farm Whole Event" [Added] = the one switch — flip it and it runs the entire event afk from scratch: takes u in, sets u up, farms, rolls thru the levels, handles the bosses, rebirths, hatches, upgrades + opens ur gifts. u literally dont touch a thing
↳ "Auto Advance" = rolls thru every level + boss on its own
↳ "Auto Rebirth" = rebirths the sec u beat the final boss for the egg luck, keeps all ur pets
↳ "Auto Hatch" = walks over + hatches ur egg non-stop, every hatch makes u hit harder
↳ "Auto Upgrade" = pours ur tokens into all the event upgrades for u
↳ "Auto Open Gifts" = cracks ur event gifts on their own for the stuff inside
